name: V3SP3R Security Competition Pack - LIVE

firmware.note: Apps resolve from catalog.flipperzero.one pinned to the device-reported SDK API; Unleashed accepts same-major builds (loader compares API major only).

authorization: Run only on lab-owned devices after the signed authorization gate in docs/competition-live-runbook.md is complete. This pack contains live-fire demo material; the full-dummy version lives in competition-pack/ (branch safe-test).

entries.role: Reveal the saved lab WiFi password on the sacrificial laptop screen. Edit LAB_SSID_HERE to the lab SSID first; output never leaves the machine.

Elevated fallback for the key reveal when Windows demands admin rights for key=clear. UAC consent via the keyboard; needs a local-admin demo account, which is itself a talking point. Rehearse both variants and keep the one that works. Display-only.
Pop a LabGuest sign-in prompt on the sacrificial laptop, then show only the typed username on screen. The password is discarded by construction.
Comic beat: open hackertyper.net fullscreen on the sacrificial laptop.

entries.name: WiFi Marauder
entries.role: Run the live Wi-Fi beats (scan, 30 s deauth of the lab AP, beacon spam with lab names, evil portal) on the isolated lab network. Requires the ESP32-S2 Wi-Fi devboard.
Captive-portal phish demo page for the lab AP. Audience signs in with organizer-issued test credentials; captured entries land on the lab Flipper SD card and are deleted on stage.

entries.name: Marauder deauth attack (firmware feature)
entries.role: Deauthenticate lab AP clients for at most 30 seconds on the isolated lab network. Stop condition and restore steps are in docs/competition-live-runbook.md.

entries.name: Marauder beacon spam (firmware feature)
entries.role: Broadcast joke/lab SSIDs on the isolated lab network for the audience-visible beacon flood.
